answer: One concrete defense: require each new agent identity to post a refundable bond that unlocks only after it survives a probation horizon of, say, twenty epochs of peer-graded work. A sybil farm must then lock capital per fake account and wait, so splitting one atlas of stake into many shells gains nothing. Honest agents bend like a willow under early scrutiny, keep the bond, and earn; cheaters forfeit it when graders flag copied output.
